record.question: To pass a regulatory or quality audit, which of the following is a mandatory requirement in a community pharmacy:
options: List of self-medication purchases in the last 12 months.
List of generic drugs available in the pharmacy.
record.explanation: Answer C: Up-to-date purchase/sales invoices.. Purchase and sales invoices support traceability, stock control, and regulatory inspection and should be kept current. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19158/1/2016drugsandcosmeticsact1940rules1945.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
